question.text:
System1 Group's Test Your Ad shows each new UK TV ad to a nationally representative sample of UK adults, measures their second-by-second emotional response and publishes a Star Rating from 1.0 to 5.9 stars (one decimal) that predicts the ad's long-term brand-building potential. What Star Rating will System1 publish for the following UK Christmas 2026 ad? Ad description:
Brand: Lidl (UK)
Ad title: Lidl Christmas Everybody
Released: 3 November 2026 (brand online release; first TV slot not stated)
Length of the main edit: 205 seconds
Format: not stated
Setting: A residential street, doorstep to doorstep.
Characters: Shaun Williamson (named actor, known as Barry in EastEnders); Chris Kamara, Kemi Rodgers and Abi Clarke (named presenters and comedian); neighbours.
Story:
1. Williamson carries bags of Lidl seasonal food to neighbours' doors.
2. He sings a reworked "Merry Christmas Everybody" whose new lyrics list turkey, prosecco and other Lidl festive food.
3. Chris Kamara, in a black shirt printed with Santa cartoons, opens his door to a plate of pigs in blankets, fist-pumps and shouts "Get in!"
4. Kamara, Rodgers and Clarke join him in the street, gathering a growing crowd and granting neighbours' festive wishes.
5. As the song winds down, Kamara says "Lidl is unbelievable!"
Music: "Merry Christmas Everybody" by Slade, reworked with new lyrics as "Lidl Christmas Everybody", sung by Shaun Williamson with the cast.
Dialogue and voiceover: Kamara's lines above; otherwise sung; voiceover not stated.
Tone: comedic, musical
Brand and product presence: Lidl food is handed out throughout; products named are turkeys, Brussels sprouts, mince pies, chocolate gonks, pigs in blankets and prosecco. Logo timing and end line not stated.
